task.description:
Implement EE-04 (Complete Task) per the design in `src/design/engine.md §EE-04`.

Read the EE-04 section of the design file in full before writing any code.

Files to modify:
1. `src/tasks/store.zig` — add `AlreadyTerminated` to `TaskError`; add `getById`; add `completeInTx`.
2. `src/engine/instance.zig` — add `CompleteTaskError` error set; add `InstanceStore.completeTask`.
3. `src/api/routes/tasks.zig` — add `handleComplete` handler.

Validation:
- `zig build` exits 0
- `zig build test` exits 0

Security checklist:
- No SQL string interpolation of user-supplied data
- All SQL values bound via $N parameters
- No secrets in source
- No `catch unreachable` on realistic failure paths
acceptance_criteria: TaskStore.getById implemented and returns TaskError.NotFound on miss
TaskStore.completeInTx implemented with status=PENDING guard (UPDATE ... WHERE status='PENDING')
handleComplete HTTP handler added to src/api/routes/tasks.zig

result.summary: Implemented EE-04 (Complete Task): added AlreadyTerminated to TaskError, getById and completeInTx to TaskStore, CompleteTaskError and completeTask to InstanceStore, handleComplete to tasks route handler
